definition: Total brands is the tenant brand registry. Priced parts are distinct brand ID plus exact whitespace-normalized uppercase SKU, across suppliers. Published current-pointer rows and legacy rows only in scopes without a current pointer contribute; prices must be accepted (published release rows), positive EUR and effective today. Failed/unpublished/previous releases, expired/future prices, and repeated supplier entries do not inflate the count.
security: No organization input accepted. auth.uid, current_profile_org_id and supplier_prices.manage are required. Execution revoked from PUBLIC/anon/service_role and granted to authenticated. search_path empty, stable read-only function, 8-second statement limit. Existing security advisor findings 3 before and 3 after; no new findings.
checks: PGlite SQL fixture: tenant/admin access, anonymous denial, unique brand/SKU, suppressed legacy scopes, expired/future/zero/non-EUR/rejected prices and invalid current publication
Production public environment verified before build
Authenticated Chrome Overview displays all three live totals
effects: 850ms easing count animation; one-shot light sweep; subtle hover elevation; reduced-motion disables animation.
refresh: Reuses panel refresh and 45-second visible-page refresh. Unknown/error totals display a placeholder, not zero.
